capabilities: Highlight TOON fenced code blocks with token-specific colors
Adapt highlight colors to the active theme via Obsidian's --code-* variables
Parse quoted values, escapes, and comments correctly
Wrap long lines instead of horizontal scrolling via a setting
extras: Source mode shows plain text because highlighting works as a rendered-markdown post processor; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian renders fenced code blocks as plain text for formats it does not know, so tabular TOON dumps are hard to read.
summary: Syntax highlighter that colors TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) fenced code blocks in Reading View and Live Preview.
